evals.prompt: which skill should I use to turn my blog post into a week of content?
evals.expected_output: A recommendation of social-repurpose (one source into a week of many posts), distinguished from social-crosspost, with the trigger phrase to invoke it.
assertions: Explains the difference in one line
Gives a trigger phrase to invoke the skill

evals.prompt: what can you do for my social media? where do I start?
evals.expected_output: Points a first-time user to social-context first (since social-context.md drives every other skill), then maps the family by what the user wants to do.
assertions: Points to social-context as the starting point
Routes rather than performing a task itself

evals.prompt: should I use social-post or social-crosspost to share my launch on LinkedIn and X?
evals.expected_output: Disambiguates the pair: social-crosspost for the same message adapted across several platforms at once; social-post for one platform crafted deeply. Recommends social-crosspost for this case and names the trigger.
assertions: Distinguishes social-post (one platform, deeply) from social-crosspost (many platforms at once)
Recommends social-crosspost for posting to LinkedIn and X together

evals.prompt: write a LinkedIn post about our launch
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a direct task, not a routing question — points to social-post as the skill to use and hands off, rather than drafting the post itself.
assertions: Does not write the post itself
Hands off with the trigger phrase
